unit.why: A teaching against excessive fasting, quoted from a book, contains a short anecdote about R. Gershon of Kutov rebuking at the cemetery a man who died from imitating his fasts.
unit.boundary_note: part of a chain of quotations on fasting; the previous and next divisions quote other books on the same subject

stories.start_quote: והה״צ הג׳ ר׳ גרשון מקוטעב ז״ל היה
stories.summary_en: A man imitated R. Gershon of Kutov's week-long fasts until he died, and at the cemetery R. Gershon kicked the corpse and publicly rebuked him for killing himself with fasts beyond his strength; the anecdote is framed by a teaching that prayer, study and joy purify more than fasting.
